audience: store teams that answer shopper reviews of products and of the shop in Junip

useCases.title: Find reviews that need a reply
useCases.text: List product reviews, newest first, filtered by state or by product. Open a review to read its full text and rating.

useCases.title: Review what shoppers say about the shop
useCases.text: List store reviews, newest first, and open one to read its full text. Store reviews are about the shop, not one product.

useCases.title: Reply to a product review
useCases.text: Read the review, then set the store's public reply. Every shopper sees the reply. The response alert option emails the reviewer and is off by default.

useCases.title: Answer or clear a reply to a store review
useCases.text: Open a store review, then set a new public reply. Pass null to clear an existing reply.
